participant_id.Description: BIDS participant label. The descriptive suffix (original, downsample, noisyhigh, noisylow, phantom) encodes the dataset's role.

Levels.real_reference: Real-style example acquisition (BIDS_example sub-01), used as the reference and as the source for the derived variants.
Levels.real_variant: A deterministic modification of the real reference (added noise or spatial downsampling); no ground truth.
Levels.synthetic_phantom: Fully synthetic DCE data generated from known parameter maps, shipping voxelwise ground truth.

source.Description: Provenance of the underlying signal: BIDS_example/sub-01 for real-derived subjects, or synthetic_dce for the generated phantoms.

dce_matrix.Description: DCE image matrix as X x Y x Z x T. For sub-01..sub-04 the DCE image is the preprocessed derivative (derivatives/.../dce/*desc-bfcz_DCE); for the phantoms it is the rawdata DCE.

dce_frames.Description: Number of DCE temporal frames (the T dimension).

temporal_resolution_s.Description: DCE frame spacing, from the TemporalResolution field of the DCE JSON sidecar.

baseline_frames.Description: Number of pre-contrast baseline frames as recorded by the phantom generator (SyntheticPhantom.BaselineImages). 'n/a' for real-derived subjects, which carry no generator baseline metadata.

vfa_flip_angles_deg.Description: Flip angles of the variable-flip-angle T1-mapping series, in degrees.

ground_truth.Description: Availability of voxelwise ground-truth maps under ses-01/gt/.

Levels.full: T1, Ktrans, ve, vp, and fp maps plus a tissue-class mask (1=muscle/fat, 2=brain, 3=vessel), an AIF mask, and an AIF time series.

description.Description: Free-text summary of the dataset's intent and distinguishing properties.
